cli.rationale: cs terminal UI. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

claude-code.rationale: Squad launches configurable agent commands in terminal sessions. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

codex.rationale: Squad launches configurable agent commands in terminal sessions. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

gemini-cli.rationale: Squad launches configurable agent commands in terminal sessions. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

aider.rationale: Squad launches configurable agent commands in terminal sessions. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

opencode.rationale: Official repository description explicitly names OpenCode as a managed terminal agent; configurable -p launch/profile route remains the mechanism.

local.rationale: Local terminal processes. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The built-in runtime launches local tmux and has no vendor-managed compute service.

own-server.rationale: Bounded scan of the v1.0.20 code and README finds no remote-host or server execution mode; cs runs agents only on the host where it is started, which maps to the local option.

worktree.rationale: Separate Git worktree per task. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

container.rationale: The inspected runtime provisions Git worktrees and local tmux sessions, without a container/VM task isolation path.

vm.rationale: The inspected runtime provisions Git worktrees and local tmux sessions, without a container/VM task isolation path.

parallel-runs.rationale: Multiple tasks at once in separate terminal workspaces. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

review-ui.rationale: Diff tab. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

self-hosting.rationale: Local cs binary with tmux and user-installed agent commands. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

license.rationale: Eligible OWN-01 identifies the Squad application source as AGPL-3.0 at ce1ffb4392b01f38e2c4599c7c84d2a93973b138, subject to component notices. No later-version grant or hosted parity is established.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The scoped AGPL application distribution has no paid product plan in the finding; users pay agent providers separately.

free-plan.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

subscription.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

per-seat.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

usage-based.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

compute.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

one-time.rationale: The complete source distribution has no paid Squad tier. Provider API fees are separate from ADE pricing.

free-tier.rationale: Free AGPL-3.0 download through Homebrew or install script; homepage shows no price. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

starting-price.rationale: No paid plan shown on the homepage or README; the application is free to install. Agent costs excluded. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

byo-subscription.rationale: Source inspection: the installed agent CLI runs unmodified in tmux, so its native sign-in applies. Not tested. Scope: Claude Squad terminal UI.

macos.rationale: The public release ships a native archive for this OS. CLI/TUI, not a GUI app; tmux/git prerequisites remain.

windows.rationale: The public release ships a native archive for this OS. CLI/TUI, not a GUI app; tmux/git prerequisites remain.

linux.rationale: The public release ships a native archive for this OS. CLI/TUI, not a GUI app; tmux/git prerequisites remain.

web-client.rationale: The pinned application/client tree contains a terminal UI and no released web-session or native phone client. The web directory is website boilerplate.

ios.rationale: The pinned application/client tree contains a terminal UI and no released web-session or native phone client. The web directory is website boilerplate.

android.rationale: The pinned application/client tree contains a terminal UI and no released web-session or native phone client. The web directory is website boilerplate.

mobile-web.rationale: The pinned application/client tree contains a terminal UI and no released web-session or native phone client. The web directory is website boilerplate.

issue-tracking.rationale: Bounded source inspection establishes session-instance persistence only, with no independent issue/task entity.

coordinator.rationale: Inspection of app handlers, CLI, config and session code found no product-supplied coordinator role or agent-to-agent delegation tools.

unattended-triggers.rationale: The inspected event handlers require human session creation or prompting. Monitor ticks and AutoYes do not start work from a schedule/external event.

multiplayer.rationale: The local TUI source has no product multi-user prompting transport. External terminal sharing is not a native shared prompt feature.

roles.rationale: Bounded inspection of the local app, CLI, config and session source found no human account/role model or enterprise SSO integration.

sso.rationale: Bounded inspection of the local app, CLI, config and session source found no human account/role model or enterprise SSO integration.

laptop-independent.rationale: In the scoped local execution path, the coding process remains on the same host; tmux detachment cannot survive that host sleeping.

pr-workflow.rationale: The inspected Git action path commits/pushes and opens a branch URL; it has no product PR management operation.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: The pinned application ships no telemetry-disable control. This does not assert telemetry collection; underlying agent controls are separate.

paid-from.rationale: AGPL-3.0 open-source CLI with no paid tier in the README, license or release metadata; agent and model costs are separate.
